description: Admin proposal and contract pages: ProposalsPage (list), ProposalEditorPage (create/edit), ProposalDetailPage (view + portal link + generate contract), ContractPage (printable), plus Dashboard 5th stat card and App.tsx routing. Depends on FEAT-P2-001 (StatusBadge, types, Sidebar update) being complete first.
steps: Create src/pages/ProposalsPage.tsx. Import: useEffect, useState from react; useNavigate from react-router-dom; FileText, Plus, Loader2 from lucide-react; supabase from ../lib/supabase; StatusBadge from ../components/StatusBadge; Proposal, ProposalStatus from ../types. Proposal colour map constant (top of file): PROPOSAL_COLORS: Record<ProposalStatus, string> = { Draft: 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-600', Sent: 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800', Accepted: 'bg-green-100 text-green-800', 'Changes Requested': 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800', Rejected: 'bg-red-100 text-red-700' }. Interface ProposalRow extends Omit<Proposal,'client'> with agency_clients: { name: string } | null. Fetch agency_proposals with select('*, agency_clients(name)') ordered by created_at desc. Filter pills: All/Draft/Sent/Accepted/Changes Requested/Rejected. New Proposal button (top right) navigates to /proposals/new. Table columns: Title, Client, Total (ETB formatted with Intl.NumberFormat('en-ET',{style:'currency',currency:'ETB',maximumFractionDigits:0})), Status (StatusBadge with colorMap={PROPOSAL_COLORS}), Expiry (date formatted as DD Mon YYYY or —), Created (date). Entire table row is clickable (cursor-pointer, onClick navigates to /proposals/${row.id}). Loading spinner and empty state follow ProjectsPage pattern.

Create src/pages/ProposalEditorPage.tsx. Import: useEffect, useState, FormEvent from react; useNavigate, useParams from react-router-dom; Plus, Trash2, Loader2 from lucide-react; supabase from ../lib/supabase; Client, Proposal, ProposalItem from ../types. The component detects edit vs. new: const { id } = useParams<{ id: string }>(); if id is present, fetch the existing proposal on mount. Form state: title (string), client_id (string), introduction (string), deliverables (string), terms (string), expiry_date (string), items (ProposalItem[]). Line items table: each row shows Description input, Quantity number input, Unit Price number input, Subtotal (qty * unit_price, read-only display). 'Add Item' button appends a new blank item with id=crypto.randomUUID(). Delete button per row. Total computed as sum of all subtotals. Save as Draft button: upserts with status='Draft' (for new proposals) or keeps existing status (for edits of Draft proposals). Publish button: upserts with status='Sent'. Both navigate to /proposals/:id on success. Read-only lock: if fetched proposal.status !== 'Draft', render a read-only view of all fields with a banner 'This proposal has been published and cannot be edited.' and a Back button. portal_token is never set from frontend — it is generated by DB default on INSERT. On INSERT use: supabase.from('agency_proposals').insert({...payload, items: JSON.stringify(items)}).select().single(). On UPDATE use: .update({...payload, items: JSON.stringify(items)}).eq('id', id).select().single(). The items column is JSONB but Supabase JS client accepts a plain array.

Create src/pages/ProposalDetailPage.tsx. Import: useEffect, useState from react; useNavigate, useParams, Link from react-router-dom; Copy, ExternalLink, FileText, Loader2, Pencil from lucide-react; supabase from ../lib/supabase; Proposal, ProposalResponse, Contract from ../types. Fetch: supabase.from('agency_proposals').select('*, agency_clients(name,company,email)').eq('id', id).single(). Separately fetch response: supabase.from('agency_proposal_responses').select('*').eq('proposal_id', id).maybeSingle(). Separately fetch contract: supabase.from('agency_contracts').select('id').eq('proposal_id', id).maybeSingle(). Display sections: (1) Page header with title, status badge (use StatusBadge with PROPOSAL_COLORS), back link. (2) Client info (name, company, email). (3) Proposal details: introduction, items table (read-only), total, deliverables, terms, expiry. (4) Portal link box: shows URL window.location.origin+'/portal/'+proposal.portal_token, Copy button using navigator.clipboard.writeText, copied feedback ('Copied!' for 2 seconds). (5) Client response section: if response exists show action badge, comment, timestamp. If no response and status='Sent' show 'Awaiting client response…'. (6) Action buttons: Edit button (only if status==='Draft') navigates to /proposals/:id/edit. Generate Contract button (only if status==='Accepted' && !contract) — on click: fetch client details, build ContractContent snapshot, insert into agency_contracts, navigate to /contracts/:newContractId. Show spinner during contract generation. Show error if generation fails.

Create src/pages/ContractPage.tsx. Import: useEffect, useState from react; useNavigate, useParams from react-router-dom; Printer, Loader2 from lucide-react; supabase from ../lib/supabase; Contract from ../types. Fetch agency_contracts by id with .select('*').eq('id',id).single(). Parse content as ContractContent (cast from JSONB). Display: (1) Print header: Connect Digitals wordmark (text-gold on navy background? No — for print use text-navy on white). Use a clean print-friendly layout. (2) Contract header: CONTRACT heading, issue date, contract ID. (3) Client section: Name, Company, Email. (4) Services table: item description, qty, unit price, subtotal — columns in ETB. (5) Total. (6) Deliverables section. (7) Terms section. (8) Footer. Print/Download button (no-print class): calls window.print(). Back link (no-print). The page itself should be white bg with dark text for print compatibility. Sidebar and Header are hidden by .no-print CSS applied in Layout (from FEAT-P2-001).

Update src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: (a) add FileText to lucide-react import. (b) add awaitingResponse: number to Stats interface. (c) in fetchDashboard(), add 5th parallel query: supabase.from('agency_proposals').select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true }).eq('status', 'Sent') — store result as awaitingRes. Add to Promise.all array. Add awaitingRes to the errors check array. Set stats.awaitingResponse = awaitingRes.count ?? 0. (d) Add 5th stat card to statCards array: { label: 'Awaiting Response', value: stats?.awaitingResponse ?? 0, icon: <FileText size={22} className='text-navy' />, accent: 'border-navy' }. (e) Change grid div className from 'grid grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4' to 'grid grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-5 gap-4'. (f) Change skeleton loader Array.from({ length: 4 }) to Array.from({ length: 5 }).

Update src/App.tsx: add imports for ProposalsPage, ProposalEditorPage, ProposalDetailPage, ContractPage, ClientPortalPage. Add routes inside ProtectedRoute > Layout: <Route path='proposals' element={<ProposalsPage />} />, <Route path='proposals/new' element={<ProposalEditorPage />} />, <Route path='proposals/:id' element={<ProposalDetailPage />} />, <Route path='proposals/:id/edit' element={<ProposalEditorPage />} />, <Route path='contracts/:id' element={<ContractPage />} />. Add public route outside ProtectedRoute: <Route path='/portal/:token' element={<ClientPortalPage />} />. The public route must be a sibling of the ProtectedRoute Route element, not nested inside it.
